meta.name: ai-image-generation
meta.description: Generate AI images with GPT-Image-2, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve and 50+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: GPT-Image-2, FLUX Dev LoRA, FLUX.2 Klein LoRA, Gemini 3 Pro Image, Grok Imagine, Seedream 4.5, Reve, ImagineArt. Capabilities: text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA, image editing, upscaling, text rendering. Use for: AI art, product mockups, concept art, social media graphics, marketing visuals, illustrations. Triggers: flux, image generation, ai image, text to image, stable diffusion, generate image, ai art, midjourney alternative, dall-e alternative, text2img, t2i, image generator, ai picture, create image with ai, generative ai, ai illustration, grok image, gemini image, gpt image, openai image, chatgpt image

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用50多种AI模型生成和编辑图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量AI图像用于创意或营销。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create high-quality AI images for creative or marketing use.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过命令行调用 50 多种 AI 模型生成、编辑和放大图片。支持文生图、图生图、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、文字渲染等功能。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑图片，并提到“FLUX”、“GPT-Image-2”、“Gemini”等模型名或“文生图”、“图生图”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张猫宇航员在太空的图片。
把这张图片的背景换成海滩日落。
say.note: Claude 会使用 GPT-Image-2 的编辑功能。

say.text: 用 Seedream 4.5 生成一张电影级肖像照。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate, edit, and upscale images using over 50 AI models via command line. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, LoRA styles, text rendering, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate or edit an image, mentioning model names like "FLUX", "GPT-Image-2", "Gemini", or keywords like "text-to-image", "image-to-image".

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut in space using FLUX.
say_en.note: Claude will call the FLUX Dev LoRA model.

say_en.text: Change the background of this image to a beach sunset.
Generate a cinematic portrait using Seedream 4.5.
say_en.note: Claude will call Seedream 4.5 for 2K-4K quality.
